AccountRow.description:

AppointmentComplete.description:
Body of `POST /appointments/{id}/complete`: the visit, exactly as `POST /visits` minus the
customer (the appointment's). Same rules: server prices, full payment, discount (D10).

check_in_at.description:
When the service happened. Default: arrival time, else the booked start if already
past, else now. Same day rules as `POST /visits` (owner may back-date).

companions.description: Companions; omitted or empty = the booking's.

package_sales.description: Packages sold in this checkout, as in `POST /visits` (spec §10.4.1, AC9.9).

companions.description:
0–5 companions known only by a note ("chồng của chị Lan", 1–100 characters): shown on
the booking, never a customer, never served or charged.

duration_min.description: Default: the services' exact durations (untimed alone = 60). 5 – 480 minutes.

group_with.description:
Book a served companion of this open appointment (spec §10.10): the new appointment joins
its group (one is opened if it had none) and must be on the same business day. The guest
phone becomes optional.

note.description: Booking note, ≤ 500 characters. Not for health data.

service_ids.description: 1–5 services, in the order they will be done.

starts_at.description:
On the spa's slot grid, inside opening hours; today up to 90 days ahead. A past day, or a
slot of today already over (the slot under way is fine), is `422 appointment.in_the_past`
for everyone: a service already done is a back-dated visit.

companions.description: Companions known only by a note (never customers, never served or charged).

customer_id.description: Null for a newcomer not yet linked to a customer record.

customer_name.description: The customer's name, or the newcomer's.

customer_phone.description: E.164; null for a served companion booked by name only (spec §10.10).

group_id.description: Shared by the people of one group (family) booking; null = booked alone.

paid_amount.description: Collected by the visit (after discount); 0 until done.

AppointmentGroupCreate.description:
Body of `POST /appointments/group`: a family booked at once, saved atomically. Each person
becomes an appointment of their own sharing one `group_id`.

companions.description:
0–5 people who come along known only by a note ("chồng của chị Lan", "gia đình của …",
Q-U5): kept on the first person's booking, never served or charged.

note.description: Booking note for everyone, ≤ 500 characters. Not for health data.

people.description: 1–6 people; an existing customer appears at most once. With no `companions`, at least 2.

starts_at.description: The new start of `{id}`; every other member still booked shifts by the same amount.

moved.description: The members that moved (`{id}` included), earliest first.

not_moved.description: Members already arrived or done: left where they were.

duration_min.description: Current catalog duration; null = "theo tư vấn".

AppointmentSettingsUpdate.description: Body of `PUT /appointment-settings` (owner): the advisory "số khách tối đa mỗi khung giờ".

max_per_slot.description: 1–200, or `null` = no limit. Required (send `null` to clear).

AppointmentUpdate.description: Body of `PATCH /appointments/{id}` (If-Match): reschedule or edit an open appointment.

companions.description:
Note-only companions, the full list (absent = unchanged, `[]` = none). Same rules as
`POST /appointments`.

customer_id.description: Link a newcomer to the customer record created for them (replaces the guest name/phone).

staff_id.description: Absent = unchanged, null = no preferred technician (not allowed once arrived).

AttendanceDay.description: One recorded day as the API shows it.

link_required.description:
The caller supervises staff but their login is linked to no profile: they record nothing
(`403 staff.link_required`) until the owner links it. Always false for the owner.

unrecorded.description: Employed days (up to yesterday in the current month) with nothing recorded.

CalendarDto.description: `GET /appointments`: the spa's grid and its appointments over `from..=to`.

max_per_slot.description:
The owner's advisory "max customers per slot"; null = no limit. Bookings are never
refused on it: the calendar shows "n / max" and warns.

technicians.description: Columns of the day view (active technicians).

visits.description:
Visits of the days recorded without a booking (walk-ins), earliest first. Visits that
completed an appointment are that appointment. Empty without `visit.read`.

CalendarVisitDto.description:
A walk-in visit on the timeline: when it was served, by whom, and where it stands. Carries no
session note (health data) and no phone.

ends_at.description: `starts_at` + the services' exact durations (untimed alone = 60), 5 min – 8 h.

staff_id.description: The first line's technician (the calendar column).

CheckoutPackageCreate.description: One package of `POST /sales/checkout`: the same fields as a package sold in a visit.

beneficiary_customer_id.description: Who the package belongs to ("Mua cho người khác"); omitted = the payer.

closer_staff_id.description: "Người giới thiệu / chốt": any staff member working here; null = "khách tự chọn".

oneOf.description: Discount on this package alone (D10; the manager cap applies per sale).

gift_note.description: Omitted = the plan's gift; empty = none.

note.description: "Ghi chú gói" of this package alone (F4), as `note` of `POST /sales`.

CommissionLine.description: Commission base of one service performed in the month.

full_value.description: Same lines at full per-session value, gift sessions included.

value.description: What the lines are worth (`visit_line.line_value`): gift sessions count 0.

temporary_password.description: Shown this once (`Cache-Control: no-store`); the owner must replace it at first sign-in.

key.description: One of the six criterion keys (`GET /evaluations` → `criteria`).

points.description:
Typed by the evaluator: 0 to the criterion's `max` (decision D). Required: `null` or a
missing value → `422 criteria.<key>.points required`; above `max` → `above_max`. The
criterion's level is computed from it.

birth_date.description:
Not after today, at most 120 years back; sets `birth_year` when that is omitted, and must
agree with it otherwise (`birth_year conflicts_with_birth_date`).

full_name.description:
Omitted/null/blank = no name: an anonymous walk-in, shown as "Khách vãng lai". A package
can be sold to this profile only once it has a name (`422 customer.name_required`).

phone.description:
Omitted/null/blank = no phone. When given: format-checked (`422 phone invalid_format`)
and unique among live profiles (`409 customer.phone_taken`).

full_name.description: The name to show: "Khách vãng lai" for an anonymous walk-in profile (`named` = false).

health_note.description: Present only for callers with `customer.health_notes.read`; null = no note.

named.description: false = the profile has no name (an anonymous walk-in); edit forms start the name empty.

phone.description: null = no phone recorded (decision E: optional).

CustomerKind.description: What kind of customer a re-engagement row is.

cancelled_at.description: Set when the package was cancelled (a voided sale or a cancellation with refund).

sale_id.description:
The sale it was sold in. `null` for a package migrated from the paper books, which
otherwise looks like any other package (EM 2026-11-05: no "sổ cũ" label in the product).

sale_note.description:
"Ghi chú gói" of the sale that created it (F4, health data). Filled only by
`GET /customers/{id}/packages` and `GET /customer-packages/{id}` for
`customer.health_notes.read`; absent everywhere else (a sale's response, a replay).

sold_price.description: Price paid after discount, in đồng.

status.description: Derived on read: cancelled → exhausted → expired → active.

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service (e.g. "Chăm sóc cổ vai gáy").

per_session_value.description: Value of one purchased session in đồng (bonus sessions are worth 0).

days_since_last_visit.description: Days from the last completed visit to today.

paid.description: Money received from this customer (before voids and refunds).

CustomerSummaryDto.description: Search hit for the counter: never contains notes.

full_name.description: The name to show: "Khách vãng lai" for an anonymous walk-in profile (`named` = false).

named.description: false = the profile has no name (an anonymous walk-in).

phone.description: National display form, e.g. "0905 123 456"; null = no phone recorded.

birth_date.description:
Not after today, at most 120 years back; sets `birth_year` when that is omitted, and must
agree with it otherwise (`birth_year conflicts_with_birth_date`).

full_name.description:
Omitted/null/blank = no name: an anonymous walk-in, shown as "Khách vãng lai". A package
can be sold to this profile only once it has a name (`422 customer.name_required`).

phone.description:
Omitted/null/blank = no phone. When given: format-checked (`422 phone invalid_format`)
and unique among live profiles (`409 customer.phone_taken`).

technicians.description: Technicians who worked that day, most visits first.

entries.description: 1–100 days; all zero and no note clears the day.

corrected_visits.description: Visits replaced by "Sửa lượt" ("đã sửa"); their newest version counts in `visits`.

customers.description: Distinct customers with at least one completed visit.

one_off_services.description: One-off services performed in completed visits.

packages_sold.description: Packages sold in sales that are not voided.

sessions_used.description: Package sessions taken by completed visits.

voided_visits.description: Visits cancelled ("Hủy lượt"); visits replaced by "Sửa lượt" are not cancellations.

DayHeadline.description: The headline numbers of another day, for "so với hôm qua / cùng thứ tuần trước".

DaySaleDto.description:
One package sale of the day list at Quầy (F6, live test 2026-11-08): a cart of packages saved
without a visit, with who bought it and who uses it.

beneficiary_name.description: Who uses the package when it was bought for someone else (US13); null = the payer.

customer_name.description: The payer's name ("Khách vãng lai" for a nameless profile).

EmploymentPeriodDto.description: One employment period (ADR-0012). `end_reason` only for `staff.manage` holders.

started_on.description: `null` = before the books (start date never recorded).

can_record.description: Decision C: whether the caller may score this person (an open month's "Chấm lại").

months.description: Newest month first; only the months the person was employed in.

link_required.description:
The caller supervises staff but their login is linked to no profile: they record nothing
(`403 staff.link_required`) until the owner links it. Always false for the owner.

coaching_plan.description: Required when the result is Mức 3 or Chưa đạt.

permissions.description: Permissions a spa loses while it is off.

FollowUpCreate.description: Body of `POST /customers/{id}/follow-ups`. The recorder is the signed-in user.

contacted_on.description: Day of the contact; default today (spa time zone). Not in the future, at most 30 days back.

next_follow_up_on.description:
When to try again (≥ `contacted_on`, ≤ 365 days after it); `null` = no next try. Omitted:
`no_answer` → contact day + 3, `will_come` → + 7, `not_interested` / `other` → none.

note.description: ≤ 500 characters. A contact note, not a health note.

FollowUpFilter.description:
`GET /customers/inactive?follow_up=`, judged on the follow-ups of the current absence
(recorded on or after `last_seen_on`; a visit since then starts a new absence).

has_more.description: More than 100 exist (only the newest are listed).

not_interested_pause_days.description: Days a `not_interested` customer stays out of `GET /customers/inactive?follow_up=due`.

today.description: The spa's business day the suggestions are computed from.

GroupPersonCreate.description:
One person of a group booking: like `AppointmentCreate`, without the shared note.
`people[1..]` are the served companions of `people[0]`: their guest phone is optional.

duration_min.description: Default: this person's services' exact durations.

service_ids.description: 1–5 services, in the order they will be done.

starts_at.description: Default: the group's `starts_at`. Must be on the same business day.

GuestCreate.description: A newcomer known by name (and phone) until they arrive and get a customer record.

full_name.description: 1–200 characters; for a companion it may be a description ("Chồng của chị Hà").

phone.description:
Required for the person who books (`POST /appointments` without `group_with`, and
`people[0]` of a group); optional for a served companion (`people[1..]`, `group_with`).

health_note.description: null or empty clears the note.

HistoryEvent.description:
One entry of a customer's timeline. `visit` / `purchase` / `cancellation` / `extension` per
`kind`; a `visit_voided` / `purchase_voided` event carries both its `visit` / `purchase` and
its `void` (one event per record, at the record's own time).

HistoryExtension.description: A package's expiry moved later ("Gia hạn").

HistoryMonth.description: One month of a person's evaluation history: the month sheet's row for them.

closed.description: Payroll closed for the month: read-only.

oneOf.description: The full scorecard, when scored (same data as `GET /evaluations?month=`).

beneficiary_name.description: Bought for someone else (US13): who the packages belong to.

note.description:
"Ghi chú gói" (F4), only for `customer.health_notes.read` (absent otherwise or when
empty), like a visit's session note.

payer_name.description:
Bought by someone else for this customer: who paid (the money fields are theirs). Null
on the payer's own timeline.

visit_id.description: The visit this package was sold in, if any.

corrected_by_visit_id.description: "Sửa lượt": the visit that replaced this (voided) one.

corrects_visit_id.description: "Sửa lượt": the voided visit this one replaces.

note.description: The session note, only for `customer.health_notes.read` (absent otherwise or when empty).

paid.description: Money received for the one-off lines (before any void).

amount.description: Price of a one-off line (0 for a package session).

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service.

customer_package_id.description: The package the session came from (`source = package`).

sessions_left_after.description: Sessions left in that package item right after this visit.

reversed.description: Money given back by reversal (positive amounts).

due_on.description:
When this contacted customer is due again: `next_follow_up_on`, or for `not_interested`
without a date, contact day + 90 (shown once more then). `null` = not contacted in this
absence (already due) or nothing due.

oneOf.description: Latest follow-up since `last_seen_on`; `null` = not contacted in this absence.

last_seen_on.description: Latest of: last completed visit, last sale not voided, last package start.

next_follow_up_on.description: The date that follow-up planned for the next try (`null` = none planned).

phone.description: E.164 as stored; null = no phone recorded (call another way, or in person).

KindSplit.description: One amount split like the paper revenue book: package sales vs one-off services.

LastFollowUp.description: The latest follow-up of the current absence.

by.description: Name of the user who recorded it.

LeaveCode.description: The absence codes, for rules that treat them differently (⚠️ #2).

LedgerDay.description: Daily subtotal of the book, for every day of the range (not only the current page).

days.description: Days of the range that have entries, in order.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next rows; `null` on the last page.

LedgerRow.description: One line of the "sổ theo dõi doanh thu hằng ngày". Outgoing money is negative.

beneficiary_name.description:
Who got the package when it was bought for someone else (`sale` / `void` rows of a
package sale; comma-separated if several); null = the customer themself.

id.description: The sale id (`sale`, `void`) or the refund id (`refund`).

note.description: Discount reason, void reason or refund reason.

one_off.description: "Dịch vụ 1 lần" column: the one-off services, comma-separated.

unpaid.description: "Chưa thanh toán": total − received (always 0 in R1, which collects in full).

upsell_by.description:
Upsell attribution ("người giới thiệu / chốt"): the closer of a package sale, the
referrers of the one-off lines of a service sale; null = "khách tự chọn".

visit_id.description: The visit the sale was made in (one-off lines, a package sold in the cart, an addition).

voided.description: The sale was voided later (its `void` row may be on another day).

Level.description: A level, ordered best (M1) to worst (Fail): `max` of two levels is the lower result.

LoginNext.description: What the browser must do after the password step.

LoginResponse.description:
Body of a successful password step. `me` is only present once fully signed in: a session that
still owes a second factor learns nothing about spas or permissions.

LoginRole.description: The roles the owner gives from the roster (the owner role is never handed out here).

Me.description: Body of `GET /me` and of a successful login.

features.description:
Features the active spa has on (ADR-0018 D4): the UI hides the others. Empty without an
active spa.

MealAllowanceBasis.description: How the monthly meal allowance (`staff_pay.meal_allowance`) is paid (ADR-0019 D3).

MethodSplit.description: One amount split by how the money moved.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code, or (for `verify`) one of the recovery codes.

MfaEnrolled.description: Result of confirming enrollment: signed in, plus the recovery codes (returned this once only).

MfaEnrollment.description: Enrollment material, shown only to the pending session that started enrollment.

manual_key.description: The same secret in base32, for typing into an authenticator app by hand.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://totp/...` URI; the client renders it as a QR code.

linked.description: `false`: this login is not linked to a staff profile (ask the owner).

MyCalendarEntry.description:
One block of a technician's own calendar. An allowlist: times, phase, the customer's name, the
services and the session note of a visit they worked on — no phone, no booking or customer
note, no money, no customer or staff ids.

group_size.description:
People booked together in this booking's group (ADR-0009), this one included; `null` =
booked alone, or a visit.

note.description:
The session note of the visit (EM 2026-11-07 item 3), sent only when I performed one of
its lines; `null` for a booking not yet done or a visit without a note.

services.description: Bookings: what was booked; visits: only the lines I performed.

walk_in.description: A visit recorded without any booking ("vãng lai").

linked.description: `false`: this login is not linked to a staff profile (ask the owner).

adjustments.description: Bonuses and penalties dated that day.

closed.description: The month's payroll is closed (figures are final).

commission_rate_bp.description: The rate the payslip applies (basis points); `null` before pay terms are set.

MyDayLine.description: One service line the person performed.

commission.description:
`value × commission rate`, rounded; `null` before the person's pay terms are set. The
payslip rounds the month's sum once, so the day's figures may differ from it by a đồng.

value.description:
What the line counts towards the commission base (the spa's rule decides whether gift
sessions count at full price).

MyDayUpsell.description: An upsell credit of the day ("giới thiệu / chốt").

kind.description:
`package` (closed), `package_refund` (a package they closed, refunded today: negative) or
`service` (a one-off service they recommended).

MyDayVisit.description: A completed visit in which the person performed at least one line; `lines` are only theirs.

note.description:
The visit's session note (`null`: none written, or the caller is a former staff member).
Sent only because the person performed a line of this visit.

MyEntryKind.description:
What an entry of "Lịch của tôi" is: a booking assigned to me, or a visit I served that no
booking of mine stands for.

MyEntryService.description: A service on a technician's own calendar entry.

from_package.description: A session of the customer's package (visits only; bookings are always `false`).

left_on.description:
Present only for a former staff member (ADR-0014): the last day they worked; the window
then ends at that month by default.

linked.description: `false`: this login is not linked to a staff profile (as `GET /me/staff`).

MyHistoryData.description:
The signed-in staff member's own evaluation history: what `GET /evaluations/history` shows a
manager, without the writer-only `can_record` and `staff_id`.

months.description: Newest month first; only the months the person was employed in.

oneOf.description: `None` before the person's pay terms are set.

left_on.description:
Present only for a former staff member (ADR-0014): the last day they worked. Months they
did not work in are `403 staff.not_employed_in_month`; the default month is this day's.

linked.description: `false`: this login is not linked to a staff profile (ask the owner).

phone.description: Vietnamese mobile number that has no login yet (one person, one spa: ADR-0016).

NoteEntry.description: One note. `customer_*` for notes about a customer, `staff_*` for notes about a staff member.

about_date.description:
The day the note is about when it is not `business_date`: the booking's day
(`appointment_note`, `appointment_reason`), the evaluated month's first day
(`evaluation_note`), the new expiry (`package_extension`).

at.description:
When it was written (a customer profile / health note or a staff HR note: the profile's
last change, EM Q-N2; an end of employment: the start of its last day).

author_name.description: Who wrote it; absent when the source does not record it (profile and health notes).

business_date.description: The business day it belongs to (the visit's, the attendance day, the contact day…).

customer_name.description: The profile's name, "Khách vãng lai", or a booking guest's name.

visit_id.description: The visit, for `visit_note`, visit voids and a `package_note` of a package sold in a visit.

NoteKind.description: Where a note was written. Each kind keeps the read rule it already had on its own screen.

kinds.description: The kinds this caller may read (the type filter offers only these).

scan_capped.description:
True when a search stopped after scanning its cap of notes before filling the page;
`next_cursor` then continues the search further back.

oneOf.description: A new customer profile, created in the same transaction (needs `customer.write`).

customer_id.description: An existing customer of this spa. Send exactly one of `customer_id` and `customer`.

customer_created.description: True when `customer` was sent and a new profile was created.

sessions_bonus.description: Bonus sessions in the original package (default 0).

sessions_purchased.description: Paid sessions in the original package.

sessions_remaining.description: Sessions still unused today, ≤ purchased + bonus.

name.description: Package name; defaults to the plan's name. Required without a plan.

package_plan_id.description:
The current plan this old package matches, if any (reference only: items and price are
what the paper book says).

paid_amount.description:
Money the customer paid for it on paper, in đồng (0 – 10 000 000 000, default 0). Above 0,
it is booked as an ordinary sale + payment on `paid_on`: revenue of that day, in the
ledger, the reports, the history and "Đã chi", like any other sale.

paid_on.description: Day it was paid (the paper date), required when `paid_amount` > 0; not in the future.

sold_price.description: Price of the package in the paper book, in đồng (per-session value, refund cap).

starts_on.description: Original registration date (not in the future).

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code, or (verify / re-auth) a recovery code.

OperatorLoginNext.description: What the browser does after the password step: always a second factor.

step_up_until.description: Writes are allowed until then without a new step-up (`null` = step-up needed now).

refund_amount.description:
đồng paid back now, 0 = no refund. At most what the customer paid for this package
(`sold_price`), else `422 refund.exceeds_paid`.

expires_on.description: The new last day of validity: later than the current one and not in the past.

counts.description: Over the whole spa (or the `q` match), ignoring `status` and the cursor.

customer_phone.description: E.164 as stored; null = no phone recorded.

days_to_expiry.description: Days from today to `expires_on` (negative once expired).

last_used_on.description: Last completed visit that used this package.

PackageUsage.description: `GET /customer-packages/{id}/usage`: one page of the paper "sổ theo dõi liệu trình".

sale_note.description:
The "Ghi chú gói" of the sale that created this package (F4), only for
`customer.health_notes.read` (absent otherwise, when empty, or for a paper-book package).

uses.description: Oldest first, like the paper page (STT 1, 2, 3…).

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service.

voided.description: The visit was voided and its sessions were put back.

PartialMonthLoyalty.description: How Thưởng gắn bó is accrued in a month the person did not work in full (⚠️ #7).

current_password.description: The current password (the temporary one after an owner's reset).

new_password.description: 10–128 characters, not the current one, not the login phone.

temporary_password.description: Shown this once (`no-store`); the person must replace it at the next sign-in.

staff_id.description: The profile of the login, when linked (its sheet holds "Đặt lại").

PasswordResetRequested.description: The one answer of `POST /auth/password-reset-requests`, whether or not the phone has a login.

reversal_of.description: `reversal` rows: the payment this one cancels (same method and amount).

PaymentStateDto.description: "Đã thanh toán chưa": R1 collects in full when the visit is recorded.

allow_incomplete.description: Close although some employed days have no attendance (default false → 422).

ended.description: The month has ended (it can be closed).

closing_commission.description:
Pay the upsell commission (§3.2): packages closed and one-off services recommended (⚠️ #3;
R1 always collects in full, so collected = sold value).

commission_on_bonus_sessions.description:
Count bonus (gift) package sessions at their per-session value for commission (⚠️ #3;
default false: a gift session earns nothing, as `visit_line.line_value`).

default_shift_start.description: Shift start used when a staff member has none (`HH:MM`, sheet: 09:00).

free_leave_codes.description:
Which absence codes use up those free days (⚠️ #2). Default: P, ĐX and K, as the sheet
counts them; a code left out is always deducted.

free_leave_days.description: Leave days per month without a pay deduction (§4: 2).

late_grace_minutes.description: Minutes late that do not count as late (⚠️ #4; default 0: every minute is recorded).

late_penalty_amount.description: Deduction per late arrival beyond the grace (⚠️ #4; default 0đ: lateness is only recorded).

meal_allowance_basis.description: How the meal allowance is paid (ADR-0019 D3).

tet_level_amounts.description: Tết bonus recorded per month for Mức 1, 2, 3 (§6: 500k / 400k / 300k).

base_salary.description: Σ of the payslips' `base_pay` (the month's base, prorated for a month not worked in full).

Payslip.description: The computed payslip. Stored as JSON in `app.payslip.detail` when the month closes.

base_pay.description:
The month's base: `base_salary` for a month worked in full, else `base_salary ×
employed_days ÷ days_in_month` rounded to 1.000đ (ADR-0019 D4). Snapshots closed before
it existed read it as `base_salary`.

base_salary.description: The monthly salary of the pay terms.

closing_commission_base.description: Upsell base ("hoa hồng giới thiệu / chốt", §3.2) = packages + recommended services.

day_rate.description: base ÷ (days in month − free leave days), rounded.

deducted_leave_days.description: Days deducted: counted days beyond the allowance + days of codes never free.

late_penalised.description: Late arrivals beyond the grace minutes.

leave_days_counted.description: Leave days that use up the free allowance (codes in `free_leave_codes`).

leave_deduction.description: Deducted days × day rate, at most `base_pay` (ADR-0019 D3).

loyalty_bonus_accrued.description: Thưởng gắn bó recorded this month (paid at the milestone; not in `net_pay`).

net_pay_shortfall.description:
What the deductions exceeded the month's pay by, not deducted: the spa bears it (flag
`net_pay_shortfall`). 0 otherwise.

tet_amount.description: Tết bonus recorded for the month (not in `net_pay`).

oneOf.description:
Tết level of the month (lower of the leave level and the evaluation); `None` = not
evaluated yet. `fail` = "không tính".

upsell_lines.description: What the upsell commission is computed from, item by item (older snapshots: empty).

upsell_package_base.description: Part of the upsell base from packages closed, minus packages refunded this month.

upsell_service_base.description: Part of the upsell base from one-off services recommended (Q-U3).

feature.description: The feature whose switch removes it, if any.

grantable.description: May a role hold it (`platform.*` and the derived former-staff permission may not).

group.description: Area: the part before the first dot (`customer`, `staff`, …).

owner_floor.description: The owner role must keep it.

owner_only.description: Only the owner role may hold it.

PhaseDto.description:
Where it stands on the desk's timeline (spec §10.1), derived when read: `waiting` (booked),
`in_service` (arrived, or its visit is within its service time), `done`, `no_show`,
`cancelled`, `voided` (the visit was voided).

PhoneCheckDto.description:
`GET /customers/phone-check`. `taken` → `existing_id` + `full_name` name the profile to open
instead of creating a duplicate (create would answer `409 customer.phone_taken`).

valid.description: The input is a complete, valid phone number (false while still typing).

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

PricesInput.description: Prices in đồng: either `all`, or `female` and/or `male` (a missing gender = not offered).

end.description: Last day of the bucket (clipped to `to`).

net_revenue.description: `revenue.net.total`, flat for line charts; only with `report.revenue.read`.

start.description: First day of the bucket (clipped to `from`).

RangePreset.description:
Ready-made periods, computed on the server from the spa's own "today" (its time zone), so
every device agrees on what "this month" is. Each has a default granularity.

oneOf.description: The preset the range came from, if any.

series.description: Every bucket of the range in order, empty ones included (continuous charts).

technicians.description:
Every technician who worked in the range, most visits first (same counting as the daily
dashboard: a visit counts once per technician however many lines they did).

top_services.description: Top 10 by sessions used + one-off services.

totals.description: Whole range; `customers` = distinct customers over the range.

Reason.description: Body of suspend / unsuspend (and every other operator write): why, for the audit trail.

code.description: Current TOTP (or a recovery code); required when the account has MFA enabled.

RefundDto.description: Money paid back when the package was cancelled (US7).

Revenue.description:
Money of a day or a period, cash basis, from the append-only `payment` and `refund` rows.
A void never deletes the original payment: it adds a reversal on the day of the void, so a
sale voided the next day still counts on its own day and shows as a void on the next.

collected.description: Money received (`payment.kind = 'payment'`), discounts already taken off.

refunds.description: Money paid back when a package was cancelled (always a package).

voids.description: Reversals of voided sales, booked on the day of the void.

RoleGrants.description: A default template, or one spa's role.

follows_template.description: Spa roles only: `true` = follows the template (a template edit changes it too).

updated_spas.description: Template edits only: how many spas changed with it.

SaleCheckoutCreate.description:
Body of `POST /sales/checkout` (EM 2026-11-07 item 4): a Quầy cart holding only packages,
saved at once. Each package is its own sale — its own plan, beneficiary, closer and discount,
exactly like `package_sales[]` of `POST /visits` — and one payment step pays them all.

payments.description:
0–2 payments, one per method, summing exactly to every package's total. The server splits
them over the sales like a visit's checkout: cash pays the sales in order first, the rest is
bank transfer.

SaleCheckoutDto.description: `POST /sales/checkout` → 201: the sales of the checkout, in request order.

total.description: What the customer paid in all (the sum of the sales' totals).

SaleCreate.description:
Body of `POST /sales`. Prices are never read from the client: unknown fields such as
`unit_price` or `total` are ignored and every amount is computed from the catalog.

beneficiary_customer_id.description:
Who the packages belong to (US13: "mua cho người khác"); omitted = the payer. Must be a
customer of this spa (`404` otherwise).

closer_staff_id.description:
"Người giới thiệu / chốt" (gets the upsell credit): any staff member currently working
here (owner, manager, technician); null or omitted = "khách tự chọn" (nobody is credited).

payments.description: 0–2 payments, one per method, summing exactly to the total (R1 collects in full).

note.description:
"Ghi chú gói" (F4). Present (`GET /sales?date=`, `GET /sales/{id}`, `PATCH /sales/{id}`)
only for `customer.health_notes.read`; null = no note. Never in an idempotent replay: the
responses of `POST /sales`, `POST /sales/checkout` and the void leave it out.

visit_id.description:
The visit this sale was made in (its one-off lines, a package sold in the cart, an
addition); null = a sale at the desk without a visit.

void_reason.description: Set when the sale was voided (US6); its payments then each have a `reversal`.

gift_note.description: Gift note for this package; omitted = the plan's, empty = none.

SaleUpdate.description:
Body of `PATCH /sales/{id}` ("Sửa ghi chú gói", F4): the note is the only field a package
sale lets the desk change in place (money and packages change through a void).

note.description:
The new note (≤ 2000 characters); null or blank = no note. Needs
`customer.health_notes.write`.

ScoredCriterion.description: One scored criterion, as stored in `staff_evaluation.criteria`.

ServiceDiscountCreate.description:
Discount on the one-off lines of a visit (spec appointments.md §5): **either** `percent` or
`amount`, never both. The server computes the amount (`percent` → floor of subtotal × % / 100).

amount.description: đồng, 1 ≤ amount ≤ subtotal of the one-off lines.

ServicePrices.description: Validated price set of one service.

SpaAuditItem.description:
One entry of a spa's own audit trail, as support sees it (spec US9 AC9.2): metadata only. No
`before` / `after`, no `reason` (free text that may name a customer), no `entity_id` (may be a
customer's id), no IP. The full entry needs the owner's support grant (ADR-0003, later).

actor_name.description: The spa member's name, or the operator's username.

is_manager.description:
The login records attendance / evaluations for others without managing staff (a
manager). Not linked to a profile, the app cannot tell which profile is theirs (decision
C): the owner is warned (F19).

manages_staff.description: The login manages staff (the owner): needs no staff profile.

staff_id.description: Staff profile already linked to this login.

StaffCreate.description: Hire: a profile plus, optionally, the login to link right away.

joined_on.description: First day of work; `null` = not recorded (the UI fills in today).

user_id.description: Login to link (an active member of this spa, not linked to anyone else).

StaffDetailsDto.description: Personal details of a profile (`staff.manage` only).

oneOf.description: The linked login (ADR-0016); absent while unlinked.

StaffDto.description: Basic staff card: no phone or personal data (`staff.read_basic`).

lock_login.description:
`true` = also lock the linked login in this spa ("Khóa tài khoản"). Default `false`: the
login stays, reaching only the person's own past attendance and payslips (ADR-0014).

attendance.description: The month's attendance, as context for "Chuyên cần".

can_record.description: Decision C: whether the caller may score this person.

compliments.description: The month's daily reviews, as context for "Phản hồi khách hàng".

phone.description: The login phone: a Vietnamese mobile no account uses yet.

StaffLoginCreated.description: `POST /staff/{id}/login` → 201: the profile, now linked, and the temporary password.

StaffLoginDto.description: A profile's login (owner only): what the account section shows and acts on.

locked.description: Locked when the person left (`lock_login`): no sign-in; rehiring unlocks it.

StaffLoginRoleDto.description: The role of a profile's login as the roster shows it.

StaffPayDto.description: Pay terms (salary data). Only ever sent to holders of `payroll.read`.

StaffProfileDto.description:
A roster entry / staff profile (`staff.read`). `details` only for `staff.manage`; `pay` only
for `payroll.read` holders who have set terms (`pay_visible` says whether pay is visible at
all). Absent means "not yours to see", never "hidden by the UI".

first_joined_on.description: Start of the first period ("vào làm lần đầu"), differs from `joined_on` after a rehire.

joined_on.description: Start of the current (or, once left, the latest) period: "Ngày vào làm".

left_on.description: Last day of the latest period, once the person has left.

login_linked.description: Whether a login is linked (decision C reads the linked login's role).

position_from_account.description:
`position` is the linked login's role name (not editable while linked; the free text
returns when the login is unlinked).

tenure_days.description: Days worked, summed over the periods up to today; `null` = a start date is unknown.

tenure_months.description: Completed calendar months, summed over the periods.

StaffProfileWrite.description: Create (hire) or edit a profile. On edit, `joined_on` is the start of the current period.

joined_on.description: Start of the current period; `null` = not recorded (tenure unknown).

started_on.description: First day of the new period (after the last period's end).

can_record.description: Decision C: whether the caller may record this person's day.

Whether the caller may record this person's attendance, praise / complaints, bonuses /
penalties and evaluation (decision C: a manager never for themselves or another manager).
Always false on `/me/staff`.

joined_on.description: Start of the latest period (older clients; use `periods`).

periods.description: Employment periods (dates only): days outside them are not workdays.

shift_start.description: `HH:MM`, the person's own or the spa default.

visit_days.description:
Days of the month this person performed a service of a completed visit (a leave code on
such a day gets a warning). Empty on `/me/staff`.

revoked_sessions.description: Sessions of the spa's members ended by a suspension.

SuggestedNextOn.description:
The next date the rules would store for a contact made today, per outcome (`null` = none).
The form pre-fills `next_follow_up_on` with it; whatever the user leaves there is sent.

not_interested.description: None: they leave the "due" list for `not_interested_pause_days`, then come back once.

will_come.description: Today + 7: check in if they still have not come.

visits.description: Completed visits in which this technician did at least one line.

TemporaryPasswordDto.description:
A temporary password, returned this once (`Cache-Control: no-store`): the owner hands it over
and the person must replace it at their first sign-in.

TenantFeature.description: A feature's state in one spa.

updated_at.description: When an operator last switched it (`null` = never: on by default).

TenantRow.description: One spa in the console's list: metadata and counts only (ADR-0003, ADR-0018 D3).

last_activity_at.description: Latest entry of the spa's audit trail.

visits_30d.description: Completed (not voided) visits in the last 30 days.

revenue.description: Sum of their prices after discount; only with `report.revenue.read`.

sold.description: Packages sold in sales that are not voided.

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service (e.g. "Gội đầu dưỡng sinh").

one_off_revenue.description: List price of the one-off services; only with `report.revenue.read`.

UpsellLine.description:
Upsell credit of one item sold in the month ("người giới thiệu / chốt", compensation-rules
§3.2, EM 2026-11-06 Q-U3): a package closed by this person or a one-off service they
recommended. Performing the service is a separate credit ([`CommissionLine`]).

kind.description:
`package`, `package_refund` (a package closed earlier, cancelled with a refund this month)
or `service`.

qty.description: Packages sold or refunded / services recommended.

value.description:
Price paid (packages, after discount), the refund as a negative amount (`package_refund`)
or `line_value` (services).

VisitAdditions.description:
Body of `POST /visits/{id}/additions` (Idempotency-Key): services or packages sold after the
visit was saved ("Thêm dịch vụ vào lượt", US12). Adds lines and sales, never changes the
existing ones, needs no reason. Same rules as `POST /visits`.

oneOf.description: Discount on the new one-off lines.

lines.description: 0–20 new lines (one-off or package); at least one line or one package sale.

package_sales.description: 0–3 packages sold now, linked to the visit.

payments.description: Summing exactly to the new one-off lines plus the new packages.

VisitConversion.description:
Body of `POST /visits/{id}/convert-to-package` (If-Match + Idempotency-Key): "Tính buổi hôm
nay vào gói" (US11, Q-U1 case by case). The one-off lines of the visit whose service the new
package covers become today's session of that package and their charge is reversed; every
other line is recorded again unchanged. Without this choice the desk simply sells the package
with `POST /visits/{id}/additions` and today's one-off stays.

package_sale.description: The package (its `ref` is ignored); it must belong to the visit's customer.

payments.description:
Only the top-up ("Khách đưa thêm"), in the method(s) the customer uses now: summing exactly
to the package plus the one-off lines kept, minus what was already paid for the visit
(empty when that covers it). The money already paid is recorded again by the server in its
own method, so the day's cash / transfer split does not move.

difference.description: New total − old total: > 0 collect more ("Thu thêm"), < 0 give back ("Hoàn"), 0 = same.

visit.description: The corrected visit (`corrects_visit_id` = the old one).

voided.description: The old visit, now `voided`, with `corrected_by_visit_id` set.

VisitCorrection.description:
Body of `POST /visits/{id}/correct` (with `If-Match` + `Idempotency-Key`): the visit as it
should have been recorded, plus the reason. The old visit is voided and this one recorded in
one transaction (spec US6b), with the rules and permissions of `POST /visits`. No amount is read
from the client.

check_in_at.description: Service time; absent = the old visit's. Must stay on the old visit's business day.

customer_id.description: May differ from the old visit's customer (recorded for the wrong person).

note.description:
Absent = keep the old visit's note (copied on the server, never sent to the browser);
null or empty = no note; text = a new note (needs `customer.health_notes.write`).

reason.description: Why (1–490 characters); the old visit keeps it as "Sửa lượt: …".

VisitCreate.description:
Body of `POST /visits`. No amount is read from the client: unknown fields such as `unit_price`
or `total` are ignored, one-off prices come from the catalog and the customer's gender.

check_in_at.description:
When the service happened (giờ làm), not when it is typed. Defaults to now. At most
5 minutes ahead of the server and on today's business day; with `visit.backdate` (owner)
up to 366 days back, and the visit, its sale and payments then belong to that day.

companions.description:
0–5 companions known only by a note ("chồng của chị Lan"), 1–100 characters each: shown
on the visit, never served or charged.

oneOf.description:
Discount on the one-off lines (D10: `sale.discount` up to the spa's cap,
`sale.discount_unlimited` beyond; reason required).

note.description: Session note incl. reactions (health data): needs `customer.health_notes.write`.

package_sales.description:
0–3 packages sold in this checkout (spec §10.4.1, needs `package.sell`). Each becomes a
sale of its own linked to the visit (`sale.visit_id`); a line with `package_ref` uses
today's session from it ("Dùng gói này cho buổi hôm nay").

payments.description:
0–2 payments, one per method, summing exactly to everything due: the one-off lines after
discount plus every package sold in `package_sales`. The server splits them over the
sales: cash pays the one-off sale first, then the packages in order; the rest is transfer.

business_date.description:
Business day of the service (`check_in_at`), which may be before `created_at` when the
owner entered it late.

companions.description: Companions known only by a note (never served or charged).

corrected_by_visit_id.description:
Set on a voided visit that was corrected: the visit that replaced it. The newest version
of a visit is the one without this field.

corrects_visit_id.description: Set on a visit recorded by "Sửa lượt": the voided visit it replaces.

note.description:
Present (on a visit and in the day list) only for `customer.health_notes.read`; null = no
note. Never in an idempotent replay.

package_sales.description: Packages sold in this visit, each a sale of its own.

payments.description: Payments of the one-off sales (the first one and every addition).

sale_id.description:
First sale of the one-off lines (none when the visit only used package sessions); later
additions have sales of their own (`lines[].sale_id`).

subtotal.description: Sum of the one-off lines before discount.

total.description:
Amount collected for the one-off lines (after discount), additions included. Packages sold
in the visit are in `package_sales`.

void_reason.description: Set when the visit was voided (US6): it stays in history with the reason.

customer_package_item_id.description:
`package` lines: the package item to use; omitted = the customer's usable package for this
service that expires soonest, then the oldest (AC4.3).

expiry_override_reason.description: `package` lines: use an expired package anyway (needs `package.use_expired_override`, audited).

package_ref.description:
`package` lines: take today's session from the package sold in this request under that
`ref` (instead of `customer_package_item_id`).

oneOf.description: `one_off` lines for a customer without a recorded gender: which gender price applies.

referrer_staff_id.description:
`one_off` lines: who recommended this service ("người giới thiệu", upsell credit); null =
"khách tự chọn". The technician (`staff_id`) keeps the credit for performing it.

staff_id.description: Technician who performed the line (required, must be working here).

category_name.description: Current catalog category of the service (e.g. "Gội đầu dưỡng sinh").

discount_amount.description: One-off: this line's share of the visit discount (0 for package lines).

line_value.description:
One-off: qty × unit price − discount share (paid now); package: value of the sessions
taken (bonus = 0).

referrer_staff_id.description: `one_off` lines: who recommended it (upsell credit); null = "khách tự chọn".

sale_id.description: `one_off` lines: the sale that charged it (the visit's first sale or an addition).

sessions_left_after.description: `package` lines: sessions left on the item right after this visit, of `sessions_total`.

unit_price.description: One-off: listed price; package: value of one paid session.

VisitPackageSaleCreate.description:
A package sold inside a checkout (`POST /visits`, `POST /appointments/{id}/complete`,
`POST /visits/{id}/additions`, `POST /visits/{id}/convert-to-package`). Same rules as
`POST /sales` for one package; the price comes from the catalog.

beneficiary_customer_id.description:
Who the package belongs to (US13); omitted = the visit's customer (the payer). A package
for someone else cannot be used in this visit.

closer_staff_id.description:
"Người giới thiệu / chốt" (upsell credit): any staff member working here; null = "khách tự
chọn". The desk defaults to the technician serving the customer.

oneOf.description: Discount on this package alone (D10; Q-U9: the manager cap applies per sale).

gift_note.description: Omitted = the plan's gift; empty = none.

note.description:
"Ghi chú gói" of this package (F4), beside the visit's session note: ≤ 2000 characters,
health data (encrypted at rest), needs `customer.health_notes.write`.

ref.description:
Client-chosen name (1–20 characters, unique in the request) that lines point at with
`package_ref`; omitted when no line uses this package today.

VisitPackageSaleDto.description: A package sold in a visit (`sale.visit_id`), as the visit shows it.

beneficiary_customer_id.description: Who the package belongs to when not the visit's customer (US13).

closer_staff_id.description: "Người giới thiệu / chốt"; null = "khách tự chọn".

note.description:
"Ghi chú gói" (F4): present exactly when the visit's session note is (a visit or the day
list read by `customer.health_notes.read`); null = no note. Never in an idempotent replay.

VisitUpdate.description:
Body of `PATCH /visits/{id}` (with `If-Match`): corrections that do not touch money or
sessions ("Sửa lượt", direct edit, spec US6b).

check_in_at.description: New service time (giờ làm): on the visit's own business day, not in the future.

companions.description: Absent = unchanged; otherwise the full list of companion notes (0–5).

note.description: Absent = unchanged, null or empty = cleared. Needs `customer.health_notes.write`.

reason.description: Why the record is voided (required, 1–500 characters); shown in history and audited.
